name: Clobetasol Propionate + Ofloxacin + Ornidazole + Terbinafine
indication_description:
This cream is indicated in the treatment of-
  • Mixed and complicated Fungal, Protozoal & Bacterial infections,
  • Mild to moderate vaginitis,
  • Candidiasis and trichomoniasis,
  • Pruritus vulvae,
  • Dermatitis,
  • Eczema,
  • Genito-urinary infections.
pharmacology_description: This cream is a combination cream which exhibits anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, anti-protozoal & anti-inflammatory actions. Ofloxacin is a broad-spectrum antibiotic that acts against many gram-positive & gram-negative bacteria. Ornidazole belongs to the nitroimidazole group of antibiotics and is used to treat amoeba and trichomonas infections. Terbinafine is an Allylamine antifungal that inhibits biosynthesis of Ergosterol (an essential components if fungal cell membrane) via inhibition of Squalene Epoxidase enzyme causing fungal cell death. Clobetasol is a potent corticosteroid which exhibits anti-inflammatory, anti-pruritic and vasoconstrictive properties.
dosage_description: Apply by gently rubbing onto the affected area twice daily.
interaction_description: No hazardous interactions have been reported.
contraindications_description: Contraindicated in patients hypersensitive to any of the components of the formulation.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: The safe use of this preparation during pregnancy & lactation has not been established.
precautions_description: Do not shallow. For external use only
storage_conditions_description: Store below 30°C. keep away from light and out of the reach of children. Do not freeze.
